purpose: Recover safely after ChatGPT message-delivery timeout or interrupted foreground tool chain without repeating durable research.

in_flight_unit.next_action: Freeze S08 historical fixture and immutable vector evidence; commit producer before Stage-A replay; then run canonical January P75 under bounded runner.

timeout_recovery_algorithm: Compare delta branch HEAD with the durable current-state commit.
If HEAD contains only committed prereg/evidence for the first incomplete unit, resume from the next missing durability step; do not rerun completed steps.
Official compute is valid only from producer bytes committed before execution and exact blob-verified locally.
Persist result, report, workbook readback, full manifest, then advance CURRENT_STATE last.
Require DELTA rebuild artifact gate success before calling the unit durable.

execution_hardening.large_stdout_policy: Keep official producers summary-only; persist detailed diagnostics to JSON rather than streaming them through the chat/tool transport.
execution_hardening.chat_delivery_timeout_policy: Treat a ChatGPT message-delivery timeout as a transport/session interruption, not evidence of compute failure. On reconnect, read CURRENT_STATE and this pointer, compare branch HEAD with current_state_commit, inspect CI and committed result/report/workbook artifacts, and resume only missing durability steps. Never rerun a completed official compute merely because the assistant message failed to deliver.
execution_hardening.github_workflow_policy: Require rebuild gate success for every durable cursor; use workflow artifacts/recovery snapshots rather than uncommitted local state.

external_references.note: Python/GitHub controls harden compute and persistence but cannot directly eliminate a ChatGPT UI/message-delivery timeout. Recent community reports show the same delivery error in long/project chats; treat them as anecdotal, not platform diagnosis.
